The Null Accelerator just swapped the places of our units!|audio = NullVoidNight3Wave25-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 25 ([[Blind Faith]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Accelerator''', internally referred to as the '''Corrupted Accelerator''', was one of the [[Boss]] enemies that appears in [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a high amount of health and an average speed. The '''Null Accelerator''' has one ability where it targets two towers, stunning them for 6 seconds. After this stun ends, these two towers have their positions swapped. This attack bypasses all forms of protecting towers from stuns, including the tower being a cliff tower, the tower having [[Stun Immunity]] and the tower being shielded by the [[Medic]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Accelerator watched the creature raise a version of his own particle accelerator, the device hummed loudly. In a flash of purple light, it fired — and suddenly Accelerator found himself standing where Engineer had been. Accelerator's mind couldn't understand. How did the Nil Zone copy something this complex, then change it?''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Accelerator''' is a corrupted recreation of the Level 5 [[Accelerator]]. It wears grey body armor which covers most of its body. On its head, it wears a grey and purple hood and a white mask, which has a hole on it. On its back, it has two grey and purple energy canisters. It has purple goo all around its body and a few spikes coming out of its skin. It fires plasma beams using its corrupted right arm. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are decent options against the '''Null Accelerator'''. **Towers with high range or with range that allows them to be effective when placed anywhere are best options against the '''Null Accelerator'''. Such towers include the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]]. *It is possible to sell and replace all swapped towers so that they are back in their original positions, though due to the '''Null Accelerator''' appearing multiple times, this is not particularly worthwhile, with the exception of towers reliant on being in a good spot like support towers. *It is impossible to protect towers from the '''Null Accelerator's''' stun, as it bypasses all forms of protecting it from them. This includes cliff towers, [[Stun Immunity]] towers, [[Temperance]] curse and towers shielded by the [[Medic]]. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} NullAcceleratorWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2025 - Present) DistortedDisplacementLoop.gif|Tower Swap animation (31 October 2025 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseNullAccel.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (31 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} NightIIIPromo.png|'''Null Accelerator''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} NullAcceleratorIconIG.png|'''Null Accelerator''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **'''Null Accelerator''' added. **{{Bug}} Killing the '''Null Accelerator''' while it is using its ability on two towers will cause the targeted towers to remain stunned until another '''Null Accelerator''' successfully swaps their places. As them being targeted again is not guaranteed, they may remain permanently stunned. **{{Bug}} '''Null Accelerator's''' model does not load in the [[Index]]. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Accelerator''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ==Notes== {{BlindFaith|[[Null Brawler]]|Wave 23|Null Accelerator|Wave 25|[[Skeleton]], [[Executioner Skeleton (Null & Void)|Executioner Skeleton]], [[Giant Skeleton]], [[Hallow Guard (Null & Void)|Hallow Guard]] & [[Null Necromancer]]|Wave 27}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
